style_guide.theme: Abandoned underground survey station: basalt ruptures, glass-quartz instruments and decayed engineer signalling
style_guide.primary: Basalt 100 / Obsidian 101; quartz 122 is the focal accent
style_guide.signalling: Cyan 77 for regular readback, Amber 79 for rare caution; static shader effects only
style_guide.rhythm: dark mass dominates bright accents; alternate 1 high shard or antenna among two low rock/industrial features
style_guide.modules: 48–88 cells width; preserve empty skyline and a real carved passage if requested
style_guide.flagship: The Glass Scar: stratified torn ceiling, broken deck joints, dry undercroft galleries and a central unwritten rift; quartz is a sparing geological fracture and cyan is an inert instrument accent.

features.title: Shattered basalt rib
features.role: Jagged mineral flank and seam grammar
placement_rules: Anchor to host rock; the fractured surface must remain legible.
Join matching low rock edges only; do not bury the quartz vein.

features.title: Split quartz fan
features.role: Asymmetric shard bloom and high-contrast focal landmark
placement_rules: Keep 8 empty cells above the tallest spire.
No active liquid should flow across the feature without native testing.

features.title: Vermilion survey antenna
features.role: Oxidised measurement rig with optical hood
placement_rules: Requires at least 51 continuous ground cells.
The glass hood is not a scanning device; static art only.

features.title: Geometric survey seal
features.role: Basalt architectural portal with actual void opening
placement_rules: Carve host terrain in centre x22..57,y26..52 before applying; missing cells are NOT auto-cleared.
Steel-grating sill is opaque to physics despite its patterned rendering.

features.title: Sealed witness cistern
features.role: Enclosed Water specimen, inspector windows, corrosion
placement_rules: Only insert into previously empty cavity; don't intersect seals.
Water ID 3 is mobile native FreeMass: containment/pressure/leakage unqualified until a real native run.
Do not connect this basin to a hydrology system without a new test.

features.title: Phosphor signal reliquary
features.role: Vertical monument with opposed optical bands
placement_rules: One major totem per 240 horizontal cells.
8 empty cells above spire; emission is purely render-side.

features.title: Fallen inspection truss
features.role: Frozen diagonal crash silhouette and loose cable motifs
placement_rules: All fragments are immovable authored solids, NOT native rigid debris.
Do not stamp over walkways without collision checks.

features.title: Sublevel survey archive
features.role: Unreadable but tactile instrument wall in glass and steel
placement_rules: Needs a floor or wall shelf; opaque DarkGlass occupies solid cells.
No actual UI or machine control interface is implied.

scene.title: The Glass Scar / fractured survey citadel
scene.classification: static dry composition (Water variant retained separately)
composition_rules: Dry preview uses the existing sealed-cistern:dry substitution (Water 3 → Empty 0); wet original remains an unqualified reusable module variant.
A fractured upper survey deck and unfilled lower geological throat split the basalt into deliberately unequal banks; dark unwritten negative space does not erase host terrain.
Original eight anchors retain identical scene origins and eight reusable feature identities; additional stratal walls, bridges, fault teeth and conduits are fixed material-cell proposals only.
Source-colour geometry tells the story of an earthquake severing a once-connected calibration citadel; neither bridge clearance nor pipes, glass optics, lighting or fluids have been simulated.

limits: No Godot rendering or native simulation was executed.
The shadow catalogue supplies flat display RGBA but not production authority.
All static parts use immovable catalogue materials. Steel grating and glass are solid hard surfaces, not pass-through.
The cistern's water is dynamic FreeMass. Intended enclosure is not empirical proof of leak freedom or conservation.
All pieces are single-plane local rectangle sets; mapping into semantic planes, priority, terrain carving and snapshots is future integration.
Glass Scar: design-only static dry flagship; module cistern still has unqualified Water default. A visible chasm or transparent glass is not tested clearance, lighting or simulation.
